data.name: Distant Barrage
data.description: As a swift action, you can expend one use of mythic power to make a ranged attack at your highest attack bonus. This is in addition to any other attacks you make this round. When making this attack, ignore the target's cover and concealment other than total cover, and add +%1 to the attack roll. Damage from this attack bypasses all damage reduction.|MythicLevel
